caseNameFull: United States v. Polakoff and Same v. Fallon
attorneys: Solicitor General Biddle for the United States. Messrs. Irving Spieler and Louis Halle for respondents in No. 295; and Mr. Myles A. Watsh for respondent in No! 296.

opinions.text:
Petitions for writs of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit denied.

Mr. Justice Murphy took no part in the consideration and decision of these applications.

Reported below: 112 F. 2d 888, 894.
